native_source: Original snapshot timestamps, ego pose and velocity, observed map road identity, four camera frame joins; synthetic_native_sample only for CPU diagnostics
review: Independently bind administrative zone establishment, installed appropriate speed sign and its face value, governed road/direction and zone bounds to the actual original sources. The Native runner emits only a context template and cannot assert these facts.
measurement: Derive zone occupancy from retained pose and reviewed axis/bounds. Convert measured velocity magnitude to mph at every 20 Hz sample in the governed zone and report frames above the reviewed authorized value without a tolerance or legal verdict.
limits: Offline and synthetic CPU tests do not establish sign authority, Native speed, physical completion, accepted recording or statutory compliance.
